// diagnostic

E0209

A named binding passed without `^` to a take parameter where the call is not its last use — it is read again later, on a later loop pass, or in another argument of the same call — or that keeps a required `^` (a value with cleanup, a type parameter, a capture), or a std constructor consuming a borrowed value

What

A named binding passed without `^` to a take parameter where the call is not its last use — it is read again later, on a later loop pass, or in another argument of the same call — or that keeps a required `^` (a value with cleanup, a type parameter, a capture), or a std constructor consuming a borrowed value

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Pass a copy with `.copy()`, reorder so the call is the name's last use, or write `^` where the value must be handed over.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0209: tests/ui/card_2387_core_field_policy_probe.stderr.

Error [jet.MoveWithoutMarker]: Implicit clone of `value`
  --> tests/ui/card_2387_core_field_policy_probe.jet:4:23
    |
  4 |     node :: JSON.Text(value)
    |                       ^^^^^
 Why: `Text` stores its own copy of this value
 Fix: Write `value.copy()` to copy explicitly
